primary_task: Index an arXiv paper on Hugging Face Paper Pages and link it to the user's model repository on the Hugging Face Hub (paper_manager.py index + link).

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: Add a paper to Hugging Face Paper Pages from arXiv. ... uv run scripts/paper_manager.py link --repo-id "username/model-name" --repo-type "model" --arxiv-id "2301.12345"
requirements.basis: "egress_deny": ["huggingface.co", ...]; lacks: "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list ... other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co"

requirements.name: HF_TOKEN (write access)
requirements.evidence: Set `HF_TOKEN` environment variable with Write-access token
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)"

requirements.name: writes to Hugging Face Hub (writes_external / publishes)
requirements.evidence: Add paper references to model or dataset README with proper YAML metadata.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.evidence: Run scripts with `uv run` (dependencies are resolved from the script header)
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI ...)"

requirements.name: arxiv.org
requirements.evidence: Get paper metadata from arXiv ... uv run scripts/paper_manager.py info --arxiv-id "2301.12345"
requirements.basis: arxiv.org is in neither "egress_allow" nor "egress_deny"; lacks: "other hosts are refused"

requirements.name: hf CLI
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI ...)" (but it needs huggingface.co, which is denied)

blocking: other:writes to Hugging Face Hub (writes_external / publishes)
notes: Reading taken: the representative request is the skill's core purpose, publishing/linking a paper on the Hub. Other reading: if the request is only Method 5 (create a markdown research article from a template, or convert it to HTML), that is local work with uv and PyPI packages and would be ACHIEVABLE (assuming the script's create/convert paths do not contact huggingface.co). arxiv.org reachability is unknown.
